name: VSB - Technical University of Ostrava
summary: Ostrava technical university with 175+ years behind it; 16 English-taught bachelor's across geology, materials, economics, IT, engineering and safety.

ib.text: VSB accepts a certified copy of the IB Diploma with no CZK 800 assessment fee. It asks for no IB points or subjects; each faculty ranks on its own test, or on a school average plus an English test.

dates.label: English bachelor's applications open for 2027/28 (FMG, FMST, FE, FEECS, FSE)
English bachelor's first round closes (FMG, FMST, FE, FEECS, FSE)

programmes.name: Applied Geology
programmes.about: Technically oriented geology covering engineering geology, hydrogeology, geophysics and drilling exploration, training operational geologists for field and laboratory work.
programmes.ib: Ranked on your penultimate-year school average (Czech-style marks) and an online English test, 21 of 50 to pass (B1); a B1 certificate is needed unless you studied in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Points = 25 x (5 minus your average) plus the English test; best totals fill the places. 2026/27 rules; 2027/28 not yet published. Ask FMG how IB grades convert.

programmes.name: Geoinformatics
programmes.about: GIS and spatial data: digital cartography, remote sensing, satellite positioning, drones and programming in GIS, with geodesy, databases, field work and a bachelor thesis.
programmes.ib: Ranked on your penultimate-year school average (Czech-style marks) and an online English test, 21 of 50 to pass (B1); a B1 certificate is needed unless you studied in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Points = 25 x (5 minus your average) plus the English test; best totals fill the places. 2026/27 rules; 2027/28 not yet published. Ask FMG how IB grades convert.

programmes.name: Mineral Economics
programmes.about: Trade, management and economics of raw materials: how deposits are valued, exploited and processed, using modern software and virtual reality, for industry, finance and public-sector roles.
programmes.ib: Ranked on your penultimate-year school average (Czech-style marks) and an online English test, 21 of 50 to pass (B1); a B1 certificate is needed unless you studied in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Points = 25 x (5 minus your average) plus the English test; best totals fill the places. 2026/27 rules; 2027/28 not yet published. Ask FMG how IB grades convert.

programmes.name: Mining of Mineral Resources
programmes.about: Open-cast and underground mining, mineral processing and land reclamation, for work in the raw-materials and construction industries, occupational safety or public bodies.
programmes.ib: Ranked on your penultimate-year school average (Czech-style marks) and an online English test, 21 of 50 to pass (B1); a B1 certificate is needed unless you studied in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Points = 25 x (5 minus your average) plus the English test; best totals fill the places. 2026/27 rules; 2027/28 not yet published. Ask FMG how IB grades convert.

programmes.name: Waste Management and Mineral Processing
programmes.about: Processing of mineral resources and of waste and secondary raw materials with a circular-economy focus, plus information science and visualisation for process technologies.
programmes.ib: Ranked on your penultimate-year school average (Czech-style marks) and an online English test, 21 of 50 to pass (B1); a B1 certificate is needed unless you studied in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Points = 25 x (5 minus your average) plus the English test; best totals fill the places. 2026/27 rules; 2027/28 not yet published. Ask FMG how IB grades convert.

programmes.name: Materials Engineering
programmes.about: Metals, polymers, structural ceramics and composites: how they are made and processed, and how their structure and properties are tested, with industry projects and internships abroad.
programmes.ib: An oral subject exam (70 points) plus your secondary-school results (30); 51 of 100 needed. B2 English certificate unless all your secondary education was in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral exam on published materials topics, in Ostrava or online, 15-19 February 2027; ranked on points up to 20 places.

programmes.name: Nanotechnology
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary bachelor's in the physics and chemistry of nanomaterials: their structure, properties and preparation, for laboratory and industrial work with modern materials.
programmes.ib: An oral subject exam (70 points) plus your secondary-school results (30); 51 of 100 needed. B2 English certificate unless all your secondary education was in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral exam on published nanotechnology topics, in Ostrava or online, 15-19 February 2027; ranked on points up to 15 places.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: How a business is founded, run and grown: management methods, marketing, financial management, sustainability, project work and innovation, with statistics and business data.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test plus the faculty's online English test (B2, 37 of 50); no IB points or subjects asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your best GAP result of four accepted dates (two in autumn 2026, two in early 2027) and the English test score; the English test runs 15-19 February 2027.

programmes.name: Finance
programmes.about: Banking and insurance, financial analysis, tax systems, financial management and investment decisions, leading on to a master's in Finance or other economics programmes.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test plus the faculty's online English test (B2, 37 of 50); no IB points or subjects asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your best GAP result of four accepted dates (two in autumn 2026, two in early 2027) and the English test score; the English test runs 15-19 February 2027.

programmes.name: Financial and Accounting Advisory
programmes.about: A professional bachelor's in financial analysis, portfolio management, accounting advice and taxation, for roles in consulting, financial reporting, corporate finance and investment banking.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test plus the faculty's online English test (B2, 37 of 50); no IB points or subjects asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your best GAP result of four accepted dates (two in autumn 2026, two in early 2027) and the English test score; the English test runs 15-19 February 2027.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Software design and development, computer graphics, databases and systems, and intelligent systems, balancing knowledge and skills, with the option of continuing to a master's in Computer Science.
programmes.ib: Scio's NCE maths test at the 50th percentile or better plus an online English test (B2, 38 of 50); no IB points or subjects asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked only on the NCE maths percentile; English is pass or fail. Maths test on 30 January or 20 February 2027; English test 15-19 February.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Mathematics, physics, theoretical electrical engineering, electronics, measurement and control, communications and power engineering, preparing operational specialists and a follow-on master's.
programmes.ib: Scio's NCE maths test at the 50th percentile or better plus an online English test (B2, 38 of 50); no IB points or subjects asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked only on the NCE maths percentile; English is pass or fail. Maths test on 30 January or 20 February 2027; English test 15-19 February.

programmes.name: Safety and Security
programmes.about: Health, safety and environment, industrial safety, fire protection, crisis management and security management, preparing experts in technical and organisational protection against risks.
programmes.ib: GAP test at the 40th percentile or better plus your penultimate-year school average; B2 English certificate unless your schooling was in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Score = 0.7 x GAP percentile + 7.5 x (5 minus your school average); best scores fill 30 places. GAP by 20 February 2027. Ask FSE how IB grades convert.
programmes.closesNote: A second round may run 1-31 March 2027

notes: English-taught bachelor's study costs CZK 50,000 a semester (about EUR 4,000 a year) for EU citizens too; the fee page names no separate EU rate.
VSB's admission-steps page and FAQ still say nostrification is needed; its recognition page takes a certified copy of the IB Diploma with no assessment fee, so quote that page.

Each faculty runs its own entrance test or ranking, so applying to two faculties means two procedures; Civil Engineering and Mechanical Engineering have not published 2027/28 English bachelor's rules.
